digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion for acceptance-criteria evidence validation
propositions: Plan review must classify every acceptance-criterion checkbox as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested with criterion-specific evidence, not keyword-only detection.
Criteria with external verification evidence require the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag; missing or malformed tags produce actionable findings naming the correct syntax.
Codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] must be rejected with findings explaining that comments cannot substitute for repository proof.
Mixed-evidence criteria bundling repository proof and outside-world proof must be rejected with guidance to split into independently certifiable criteria.
High-confidence evidence misclassification findings must participate in normal plan-review blocking policy while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open.
